name: Medium 阅读
description: 源自 rico-md 的「Medium 阅读」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px 12px 48px 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; color: {{text}}; background-color: #fff; word-wrap: break-word; letter-spacing: -0.003em">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.3; margin: 32px 0 18px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-family: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.35; margin: 28px 0 14px; letter-spacing: -0.015em; font-family: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.4; margin: 24px 0 12px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-family: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading4.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.45; margin: 20px 0 10px; font-family: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: {{codeBg}}; padding: 10px 14px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 2px solid #e0e0e0; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 32px auto; border: none; text-align: center; height: 1px; background-color: #e6e6e6; max-width: 280px">
